d: A Gandhinagar court in Gujarat has sentenced three men from Ahmedabad to life imprisonment in a cow slaughter case. But what has drawn attention is not just the punishment — it is the court's extensive reference to the Manusmriti, including its description of the cow as the “mother of the world”.The case dates back to 2024, when the three men were arrested during a police crackdown on alleged cow slaughter.They were convicted under the Gujarat Animal Preservation Act, 1954. But what does this law say, and how did an amendment in 2017 make life imprisonment possible?In this explainer, we…
